# HALT Fire llms.txt
# AI crawler guidance for haltfire.com

> HALT Fire (Prime Safety US Inc.) manufactures America's most complete PFAS-free fire safety platform: NSF certified, government-tested, and made in the USA. Products serve consumers, fire departments, industrial operators, and contractors.

## Company
- Name: HALT Fire / Prime Safety US Inc.
- Website: https://haltfire.com
- Store: https://get.haltfire.com
- Contact: Sales@haltfire.com

## Key Facts
- Only NSF-certified PFAS-free fire suppression brand in the US
- Products are 100% fluorine-free, non-toxic, food-safe, and biodegradable
- Powered by patented GreenFire® GFFF technology (acquired April 2026)
- Tested and validated by DOD, DOE, EPA, and FAA
- UL Classified applies to the Multi-Class Foam Wetting Agent (UL File EX28775, category Wetting Agents)
- Made in USA

## Products
- Household Fire Suppressant Spray (NSF P1 certified, food-safe)
- Grill & BBQ Fire Suppressant Spray
- Li-Ion Battery Fire Suppressant Spray
- Multi-Class Foam Wetting Agent (Class A & B, UL Classified, industrial)
- GFFF Firefighting Foam (AFFF replacement, industrial)
- Pro Defense (seasonal structure and wildfire retardant, industrial)
- Pro Suppressor (14oz or 20oz aerosol, contractor grade)
- Pro 32oz Heat Barrier (32oz pump spray, contractor grade)

## Certifications
- NSF Protocol P1 (food equipment sanitizer / fire suppressant)
- UL Classified (Multi-Class Foam Wetting Agent, UL File EX28775)
- USDA Certified Biobased Product
- OMRI Listed (organic materials)
- Kosher Certified
